description: This file implements the MiracastP2P class responsible for managing Wi-Fi Direct (P2P) interactions for Miracast. It includes initialization, device discovery, connection management, event handling via a monitor thread, and configuration of Wi-Fi display parameters.

classes.name: MiracastP2P
classes.description: A class managing Wi-Fi P2P operations for Miracast, including initialization, discovery, connection, event monitoring, and configuration.

methods.name: p2pInit
methods.description: Initializes Wi-Fi P2P interface and sets up communication with wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: p2pUninit
methods.description: Performs cleanup and shutdown of the P2P interface and monitor thread.

methods.name: discover_devices
methods.description: Starts device discovery in P2P mode.

methods.name: connect_device
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a P2P device with specified MAC and authentication type.

methods.name: set_FriendlyName
methods.description: Sets the friendly name for the device, optionally applying it to the system.
